installer.title: Retail POS Installation Wizard
installer.subtitle: Step-by-step setup guide for your Retail POS & E-Commerce System
installer.welcome_desc: Thank you for choosing our Omnichannel Retail POS & E-Commerce platform. This automated setup wizard will guide you through configuring your database, generating security keys, initializing roles, creating the administrator account, and setting up your store details in just a few minutes.
installer.welcome_feature_pos: High-Speed Physical Point of Sale Terminal with Thermal Receipt Support
installer.welcome_feature_ecommerce: 24/7 Online Customer Storefront with Live Order Tracking
installer.welcome_feature_inventory: Real-time Synchronized Inventory & Multi-Unit Stock Management
installer.welcome_feature_marketing: Automated Marketing, Customer Segmentation & Multi-Channel Notifications
installer.welcome_feature_multilingual: 5-Language System with Native Arabic & Urdu RTL Mirroring
installer.requirements_desc: The installer verifies that your server meets the minimum requirements to run the Retail POS system reliably.
installer.all_requirements_passed: All system requirements are satisfied! You can proceed to the next step.
installer.requirements_failed_warning: One or more critical requirements are missing. Please enable them in your php.ini or hosting environment before continuing.
installer.permissions_desc: The application requires write permissions to store cache, sessions, logs, and configuration files.
installer.all_permissions_passed: All critical directories are writable! You can proceed with database setup.
installer.permissions_failed_warning: Some directories are not writable. Please grant write permissions (e.g. chmod 775 or full write access in Windows/XAMPP).
installer.database_desc: Provide your MySQL or MariaDB database credentials. If the database does not exist, the installer will attempt to create it automatically.
installer.db_password_placeholder: Enter database password (leave blank if empty)
installer.db_notice: Your database password is encrypted and never exposed in browser logs or error responses.
installer.connection_failed: Failed to connect to the database. Please review your credentials.
installer.app_config_desc: Configure the core settings for your store. An encryption APP_KEY will be automatically generated.
installer.admin_desc: This account will serve as the Super Administrator with full privileges to the POS counter, products, orders, and system settings.
installer.business_desc: Enter your store details. These will appear on POS thermal receipts, customer invoices, and the public storefront.
installer.installing_desc: Please wait while the system sets up your database, runs migrations, seeds initial data, and generates security credentials. Do not close or refresh this page.
installer.stage_writing_env: Writing environment configuration (.env) and generating encryption key...
installer.stage_saving_settings: Saving business details and store configuration...
installer.stage_locking_installer: Creating permanent security lock and finalizing...
installer.complete_desc: Your Retail POS & Omnichannel Commerce Platform is now fully installed and ready for operations.
installer.security_note: For maximum security, the installation wizard has been permanently locked. Reinstallation is disabled.
installer.already_installed_desc: The Retail POS system has already been installed on this server. For security reasons, the installer cannot be run again.
